checklist: every command in the slicc.commands of the tarballs under test (bios's base set, slicc-kernel itself left out) runs its invocation below, --version by default, as root (cwd /root) and as kernel.users.add({name:'cone'}) (cwd /home/cone), with empty stdin, and exits with the expected status (0 unless rc says otherwise) within commandTimeoutMs
a command name two packages define is run once, for the package whose name sorts first (the kernel's rule since 1.74)

real use, each in a fresh mktemp -d as both users: grep -c / -n / egrep / fgrep, sed -i and sed -n, xz -k and xz -dc, jq -c, find -type f piped to xargs, diff -u (rc 1) and cmp, patch applying a unified diff

kernel-compat runs it under users report and enforce; HOMESCOOP_SWEEP_OUT gets one row per user and command, HOMESCOOP_SWEEP_ONLY (a JSON list of command names, real:<tool> for the real-use cases) limits the run to those

pgrep.sh: sleep 5 & p=$!; pgrep -x sleep >/dev/null; r=$?; kill $p; exit $r

pidof.sh: sleep 5 & p=$!; pidof sleep >/dev/null; r=$?; kill $p; exit $r

pkill.sh: sleep 5 & pkill -x sleep; r=$?; wait; exit $r

grep.sh:
cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf 'alpha
beta
gamma
' > s.txt && test "$(grep -c a s.txt)" = 3 && test "$(grep -n beta s.txt)" = 2:beta && test "$(egrep '^g' s.txt)" = gamma && test "$(fgrep -x beta s.txt)" = beta

sed.sh: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf 'alpha\nbeta\n' > s.txt && sed -i s/beta/BETA/ s.txt && test "$(sed -n 2p s.txt)" = BETA

xz.sh: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf 'hello\n' > s.txt && xz -k s.txt && test -f s.txt && test "$(xz -dc s.txt.xz)" = hello

find.sh: cd "$(mktemp -d)" && mkdir -p t/u && touch t/a t/u/b && test "$(find t -type f | sort | xargs echo)" = 't/a t/u/b'

diff.sh:
cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf 'a
' > s.txt && printf 'a
b
' > t.txt; diff -u s.txt t.txt > d.patch; test $? = 1 && test "$(tail -1 d.patch)" = +b && cmp -s s.txt s.txt

patch.sh:
cd "$(mktemp -d)" && printf 'a
' > s.txt && printf -- '--- s.txt
+++ s.txt
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
 a
+b
' > d.patch && patch -s s.txt < d.patch && test "$(tail -1 s.txt)" = b
